definitions.explanation: a persistent argument where neither side yields, each pushing their own position

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{押|お}し{問答|もんどう}になった。
examples.english: There was an argument at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{押|お}し{問答|もんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: We went back and forth arguing about the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{押|お}し{問答|もんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: After a long dispute, we reached an agreement.

notes:
FORMS:
- {押|お}し (pushing - from ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧)
- {問答|もんどう} (questions and answers, dialogue)
→ A dialogue where both sides "push" their position

VERB USAGE:
- {押|お}し{問答|もんどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to turn into an argument)
- {押|お}し{問答|もんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to argue back and forth repeatedly)
- {押|お}し{問答|もんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ (after arguing)

USAGE:
Implies a somewhat stubborn exchange where both parties insist on their position, not necessarily hostile but often tedious or unproductive.
